card.name: Decimal point in syringe and needle sizes
card.fires_on: The decimal point after a leading 0 in syringe or needle sizes such as 0.3 mL or 0.5 inch. It also fires on 'In an/a' opening a study description in a warnings subsection.

modes.label: Decimal point after 0
modes.description: The period after a leading zero in a syringe volume or needle length.

modes.label: Study-opening article
modes.description: The word an or a after 'In' at the start of a warnings subsection describing a trial.
